full_prompt_en: A square, carefully composed landscape painting shows a small group of women standing among tall white flowers beside a quiet river. The figures cluster in the left half, all facing the water and the open right side of the frame. The nearest, tallest woman wears a warm ochre dress with a wide white collar and white head covering; a long black shawl falls straight down her back and front. Behind her, a dark-haired woman in cream and brown is partly hidden. To the right, a red-haired figure and a smaller pale-capped face appear between shoulders, adding a stepped sequence of profiles. Their forms are simplified and still, with pale faces and fabric planes clearly separated against the darker bank. White blossoms rise across the lower left and center, their narrow green stems making a fine vertical screen around the women. A few orange-red flowers punctuate the pale cluster. The river occupies the entire right half and extends behind the group in broad green and silver reflections, its smooth surface broken only by subdued horizontal strokes. On the far bank, rolling olive fields and a dense group of dark trees climb toward a low cloudy sky. A light birch trunk at the far left and the dark tree group across the water give the scene balanced vertical anchors. The paint is matte and detailed, with flowers, garments, and foliage built from small controlled marks while the water remains comparatively broad and calm. Soft daylight filters through thin cloud from above, lighting pale headwear, blossoms, and water without strong cast shadows. The overall composition balances a close, quiet human cluster and textured flowers against a spacious reflective river and measured green hills.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、构图审慎的风景画描绘一小群女子站在宁静河畔高高的白花之间。人物聚在左半边，都面向水面与画面开放的右侧。最近且最高的女子穿暖赭黄色裙子，配宽白领与白头巾；一条长黑披巾从背后与身前直直垂下。她身后，一名穿奶油与褐色衣服的黑发女子部分被遮住。右侧，红发人物与一张戴浅色小帽的较小面孔在肩膀之间出现，构成逐级降低的侧影序列。她们形体简化且静止，浅色面庞与衣料平面在较深河岸前清楚分离。白花从左下与中央升起，细绿茎秆在女子周围形成纤细纵向屏障。少量橙红花点穿插于浅色花群。河水占据整个右半边，也延至人物后方，以宽阔绿与银色倒影表现，平滑水面只由低调横笔打断。对岸，起伏的橄榄色田野与一群深色树木上升至低云天空。最左边的浅色白桦树干与对岸深树群给场景提供平衡的纵向支点。颜料哑光且细致，花、衣服和枝叶由受控小笔触建立，水面则相对宽阔安静。柔和日光从上方薄云中滤下，照亮浅色头巾、花朵和河水，没有强烈投影。整体构图以靠近的宁静人物群和有肌理的花，平衡开阔反光河流与有节制的绿丘。
style_prompt_en: The image has a matte, carefully observed painted finish with smooth broad planes beside clusters of fine vertical marks. Olive green, muted ochre, cream, charcoal, and silver-gray are arranged in calm areas, with a few red-orange accents giving gentle punctuation. Nearby contours remain legible but restrained, and distant slopes soften into long horizontal layers. A close textured zone is balanced by open reflective space, so detail never fills the whole frame. Light is diffused through thin cloud, brightening pale upper surfaces and reflective passages while shadows stay shallow and colored. The overall effect is serene and formal, built from steady profiles, measured color bands, and delicate foreground repetition.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有哑光、观察细致的绘画完成面，平滑宽阔平面与细密纵向笔迹成簇并置。橄榄绿、低饱和赭黄、奶油、炭灰和银灰组织成安静色域，少量红橙重音轻轻点缀。近处轮廓可读而克制，远坡柔化为长横向层。靠近的肌理区与开放反光空间平衡，因此细节没有填满全幅。光经薄云漫射，提亮浅色上表面与反光通道，阴影保持浅而有色。整体效果宁静、端整，由稳定轮廓、有节制色带和细致前景重复建立。
theme_en: A small group of women among white flowers beside a quiet river
theme_zh: 一群女子站在河畔白花间，眺望平静的水面
name: Mikhail Nesterov
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
